settings.q: My honey has gone thick and grainy. Is it spoiled?
settings.a: No. Raw honey naturally crystallises over time, especially in cooler weather. Stand the closed jar in warm (not boiling) water and stir to make it runny again.
Each jar comes from one region and one main flower source, so every honey has its own colour, aroma and taste.

settings.q: Is BeeBlend honey pure and raw?
settings.a: Yes. Every jar is pure honey with nothing added: no sugar, syrups or preservatives. It is extracted and gently filtered but never heated, which is why it crystallises naturally.

settings.q: Which honey should I buy first?
settings.a: For tea and everyday use, start with Kashmiri Acacia or Himalayan Multiflora. Still deciding? Our honey guide helps you find your match.
